dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm thirsty. Is there a convenience store near here?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈθɜːrsti. ɪz ðɛr ə kənˈviːniəns ˌstɔːr ˈnɪr ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's on the corner. Let's buy snacks, too!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər. ˈlɛts ˈbaɪ ˈsnæks, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK! Oh, look! They have chips.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈoʊ, ˈlʊk! ðeɪ ˈhæv ˈtʃɪps.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love chips! And I'd like a soda.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈtʃɪps! ənd aɪd ˈlaɪk ə ˈsoʊdə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Soda is too sweet for me. I'd like a bottle of water.
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊdə ɪz ˈtuː ˈswiːt fər miː. aɪd ˈlaɪk ə ˈbɑːtəl əv ˈwɔːtər.
